findings.message: The horizontal list Flex sets direction='row' with no `wrap`, so items can't wrap onto a new line and overflow their container. A chart with 8–9 series, or long series names, in a narrow card: all items stay on one row and spill past the container edge (or get clipped by overflow:hidden), since the list Flex has no flex-wrap and the Legend props omit nothing that would let callers fix it on the inner list.

`label ?? 'Chart legend'` only falls back for null/undefined, but the visible label is gated on truthiness, so `label=""` renders no label and sets aria-label="" on the list. A caller passes `label={title}` where title is ''. No visible label renders, and the role=list gets an empty accessible name instead of the 'Chart legend' fallback, so screen readers announce an unnamed list.
